text_block_list.text:

but... I dunno, it kinda feels like fate 
playing tricks on me.

text_block_list.text:
It wasn't a magnificent 1st place, nor a 
2nd place where struggling just a little 
harder might have...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, a solid 3rd place. How do I put 
it... it just feels so typical of me.

Still, there's no doubt that's a wonderful 
result.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:

you know?

text_block_list.text:

well for myself right now.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:

I've gotta step it up a notch, no, two 
notches higher.

within reach!

to celebrate 3rd place—that's a Trainer's
